name: GCP Jump Host Automation Agent
description: Executes pre-staged PowerShell scripts from the PowerShell Jump Host (geap-windows-ps-jumphost) and pre-staged Ansible playbooks from the Linux Ansible Jump Host (geap-linux-ansible-jumphost) against remote target VMs without custom OS MCP servers.

skills.name: Ansible Playbook Execution via Linux Jump Host
skills.description: Runs pre-staged Ansible playbooks (linux_health_check.yml, linux_service_status.yml, linux_disk_cleanup.yml) from geap-linux-ansible-jumphost against target Linux VMs (geap-private-http).
examples: Run the linux_health_check.yml Ansible playbook from the Ansible jump host on geap-private-http

skills.name: PowerShell Script Execution via PowerShell Jump Host
skills.description: Runs pre-staged PowerShell scripts (windows_health_check.ps1, windows_service_status.ps1, windows_temp_cleanup.ps1) from geap-windows-ps-jumphost against remote target VMs (geap-windows-target / 10.200.21.10).
examples: Run windows_health_check.ps1 from the PowerShell jump host against geap-windows-target (10.200.21.10)
Execute windows_temp_cleanup.ps1 on the remote target VM via the PowerShell jump host
